description: Source code for dynamically loading the libde265 library and defining function pointers for its functions, including a handle class for managing library loading and unloading.

classes.name: Libde265Handle
classes.description: Manages loading and unloading of the libde265 shared library, including symbol initialization and error handling.

methods.name: Libde265Handle
methods.description: Constructor that loads the library and initializes symbols.

methods.name: ~Libde265Handle
methods.description: Destructor that closes the library handle if loaded.

methods.name: IsLoaded
methods.description: Checks if the library handle is successfully loaded.

methods.name: ReportSymbolError
methods.description: Logs an error if symbol loading fails and closes the handle.

methods.name: LoadLibrary
methods.description: Loads the shared library and initializes function pointers.
